en.s: The Battle of Karbala took place on Muharram 10, in the year 61 AH of the Islamic calendar (October 10, 680 AD) in Karbala, in present-day Iraq. The battle took place between a small group of supporters and relatives of Muhammad's grandson, Husayn ibn Ali, and a larger military detachment from the forces of Yazid I, the Umayyad caliph. When Muawiyah I died in 680, Husayn did not give allegiance to his son, Yazid I, who had been appointed as Umayyad caliph by Muawiyah; Husayn considered Yazid's succession a breach of the Hasan–Muawiya treaty.

zh.s: 卡尔巴拉之战发生于伊斯兰历61年穆哈兰月10日（公元680年10月10日），地点在今伊拉克的卡尔巴拉。参战双方是穆罕默德之孙侯赛因·伊本·阿里的一小群支持者和亲属，以及倭马亚哈里发耶齐德一世麾下人数更多的一支军队。680年穆阿维叶一世去世后，侯赛因没有向其子耶齐德一世效忠。穆阿维叶曾任命耶齐德为倭马亚哈里发；侯赛因认为，耶齐德继位违反了《哈桑—穆阿维叶条约》。

en.s: The Battle of Tours (10 October 732) — also called the Battle of Poitiers and, by Arab sources, the Battle of the Palace of the Martyrs (Arabic: معركة بلاط الشهداء‎, translit. Ma'arakat Balāṭ ash-Shuhadā’‎) — was fought in an area between the cities of Poitiers and Tours, in north-central France, near the village of Moussais-la-Bataille, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) northeast of Poitiers. The location of the battle was close to the border between the Frankish realm and then-independent Aquitaine. The battle pitted Frankish and Burgundian forces under Charles Martel against an army of the Umayyad Caliphate led by 'Abdul Rahman Al Ghafiqi, Governor-General of al-Andalus.

zh.s: 图尔之战（732年10月10日）也称普瓦捷之战；阿拉伯史料称其为“烈士宫之战”（阿拉伯语：معركة بلاط الشهداء，转写：Ma'arakat Balāṭ ash-Shuhadā’）。战场位于法国中北部普瓦捷和图尔两城之间，靠近穆塞-拉-巴塔耶村，距普瓦捷东北约20公里（12英里）。战场靠近法兰克领地与当时独立的阿基坦之间的边界。查理·马特率领的法兰克和勃艮第军队与阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·加菲基率领的倭马亚哈里发国军队交战；加菲基当时是安达卢斯总督。

en.s: The siege of Messina was launched by the Aghlabids, allied with the Neapolitans, against the Byzantine city of Messina from 842 to 843. The Allied forces managed to capture the city after a long siege.

zh.s: 842年至843年，阿格拉布王朝军队与那不勒斯盟军围攻拜占庭城市墨西拿。经过长期围城，联军最终攻占该城。

en.s: The Battle of Crug Mawr (Welsh: Brwydr Crug Mawr), sometimes referred to as the Battle of Cardigan, took place in September or October 1136, as part of a struggle between the Welsh and Normans for control of Ceredigion, West Wales. The battle was fought near Penparc, northeast of Cardigan, probably on the hill now known as Banc-y-Warren; it resulted in a rout of the Norman forces, setting back their expansion in West Wales for some years.

zh.s: 克鲁格毛尔之战（威尔士语：Brwydr Crug Mawr），有时也称卡迪根之战，发生于1136年9月或10月，是威尔士人与诺曼人争夺西威尔士塞雷迪吉恩控制权的冲突之一。战斗地点在卡迪根东北部的彭帕克附近，可能就在如今称为班克-沃伦的山丘上。诺曼军队在此战中溃败，其在西威尔士的扩张因此受阻数年。

en.s: The Battle of Karanovasa (lit. "Battle of the Trenches") took place on 10 October 1394 between the Wallachian army led by Voivode Mircea cel Bătrân against an Ottoman invasion led by Sultan Bayezid I. This battle is sometimes confused with the later Battle of Rovine (lit. "Battle of the Marshes", Rovine is old Romanian-Latin for ruins, modern Italian rovinare to tear down) between the same combatants, and which took place also along the valley of the Argeş River.

zh.s: 卡拉诺瓦萨战役（意为“战壕之战”）于1394年10月10日爆发，瓦拉几亚军队由统治者米尔恰一世率领，对阵苏丹巴耶济德一世率领的奥斯曼入侵军。这场战役有时会与后来同一批交战者在阿尔杰什河谷进行的罗维讷战役（意为“沼泽之战”）混淆。Rovine是旧罗马尼亚语中“废墟”之意，与现代意大利语动词rovinare（“摧毁”）有关。

en.t: Polish forces defeat the Teutonic Order near Koronowo
en.s: On 10 October 1410, Polish forces defeated the Teutonic Order near Wilcze, about 11 kilometers northwest of Koronowo, during the Polish–Lithuanian–Teutonic War.

zh.t: 波兰军队在科罗诺沃附近击败条顿骑士团
zh.s: 1410年10月10日，波兰军队在维尔切附近击败条顿骑士团。维尔切位于科罗诺沃西北约11公里处。

en.s: The Battle of Mokra took place on October 10, 1445 near mountain Mokra (today in Makedonski Brod, Macedonia). It was an Ottoman retaliation to a message sent by Skanderbeg to Murad II. The Albanian forces under Skanderbeg defeated the Ottoman forces under Firuz Pasha. It was the second major Albanian victory over the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 莫克拉战役于1445年10月10日在莫克拉山附近爆发，地点在今北马其顿马其顿布罗德。奥斯曼帝国此战是为了报复斯坎德培送给穆拉德二世的一封信。斯坎德培率领的阿尔巴尼亚军队击败了菲鲁兹帕夏率领的奥斯曼军队。这是阿尔巴尼亚人第二次在大战中战胜奥斯曼帝国。

en.s: The Battle of Brunkeberg was fought on 10 October 1471 between the Swedish regent Sten Sture the Elder and forces led by Danish king Christian I. Sture won a decisive victory, weakening the Kalmar Union considerably and becoming the effective ruler of Sweden as Lord Regent for most of his remaining life.

zh.s: 布伦克贝格之战于1471年10月10日爆发，交战双方是瑞典摄政王老斯滕·斯图雷与丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世率领的军队。斯图雷取得决定性胜利，大幅削弱卡尔马联盟的势力，并成为瑞典实际上的统治者，在余生的大部分时间担任摄政王。

en.s: The Battle of Tillieangus was fought on 10 October 1571 between the Clan Gordon and the Clan Forbes near White Hill of Tillyangus, Aberdeenshire, Scotland. It was part of the Marian civil war in which the Gordons supported Mary, Queen of Scots and the Forbeses supported her son, James VI of Scotland.

zh.s: 蒂利安格斯之战于1571年10月10日在苏格兰阿伯丁郡白山附近爆发，交战双方是戈登氏族和福布斯氏族。此战是玛丽内战的一部分：戈登氏族支持苏格兰女王玛丽，福布斯氏族则支持她的儿子、苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世。

en.s: The Battle of Dormans was a battle during the 5th War of Religion in France. It occurred near the village of Dormans, more precisely between Tréloup and Verneuil, on 10 October 1575. It was an encounter between royal troops commanded by Henry, 3rd Duke of Guise and a body of German reiters recruited by the Protestants, notably the English Protestants and the Malcontents (duc d'Alençon) led by Thoré, the younger brother of the maréchal de Montmorency and of Henri comte de Damille. The inhabitants of Dormans had destroyed the wooden bridge linking the village to the other bank of the River Marne before the battle.

zh.s: 多尔芒之战是法国第五次宗教战争期间的一场战斗。1575年10月10日，战斗发生在多尔芒村附近，更具体地说是在特雷卢和韦尔讷伊之间。吉斯公爵亨利率领王室军队，与新教徒招募的一支德国轻骑兵部队交战。后者主要由英国新教徒和阿朗松公爵的“政见不满者”组成，由托雷率领；托雷是蒙莫朗西元帅和达米耶尔伯爵亨利的弟弟。战前，多尔芒居民拆毁了连接村庄与马恩河对岸的木桥。

en.s: The Second Desmond Rebellion (1579–1583) was the more widespread and bloody of the two Desmond Rebellions in Ireland launched by the FitzGerald Dynasty of Desmond in Munster against English rule. The second rebellion began in July 1579 when James FitzMaurice FitzGerald landed in Ireland with a force of Papal troops, triggering an insurrection across the south of Ireland on the part of the Desmond dynasty, their allies, and others who were dissatisfied for various reasons with English government of the country.
en.n: Over 600 Papal troops land in Ireland to support the Second Desmond Rebellion.

zh.s: 第二次德斯蒙德叛乱（1579—1583年）是爱尔兰芒斯特地区菲茨杰拉德家族发动的两次德斯蒙德叛乱中规模更大、伤亡更惨重的一次，目标是反抗英国统治。1579年7月，詹姆斯·菲茨莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德率领教皇国军队登陆爱尔兰，叛乱由此爆发，并蔓延至爱尔兰南部；德斯蒙德家族、其盟友及其他对英国统治不满的人纷纷参与。
zh.n: 600多名教皇国军队士兵登陆爱尔兰，支援第二次德斯蒙德叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Hastivanj was fought between armies of Mughal Empire under Qasim Khan and Kashmir Sultanate under Shams Chak. It was fought on 10 October 1586 on a mountain ridge known as Hastivanj near modern-day Pir Ki Gali Pass. It resulted in Mughal victory and subsequent annexation of Kashmir into Mughal Empire. The battle, along with the fall of Srinagar on 14 October 1586, marks the de facto end of the Mughal conquest of Kashmir.

zh.s: 哈斯提万杰战役于1586年10月10日爆发，交战双方是卡西姆汗率领的莫卧儿帝国军队与沙姆斯·查克率领的克什米尔苏丹国军队。战场位于一处名为哈斯提万杰的山脊，靠近今皮尔基加利山口。莫卧儿军队获胜，随后吞并克什米尔。此战以及1586年10月14日斯利那加陷落，标志着莫卧儿征服克什米尔事实上结束。

en.s: The Battle of Belleek, also known as the Battle of the Erne Fords, was fought on the River Erne near Belleek in Fermanagh, Ireland, on 10 October 1593. It was part of the buildup to the Nine Years' War. The battle was fought between a Gaelic Irish army under Hugh Maguire, lord of Fermanagh—who had begun a revolt against the English—and an English Crown expeditionary force under Sir Henry Bagenal, supported by Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone.

zh.s: 贝莱克之战又称厄恩河渡口之战，于1593年10月10日在爱尔兰弗马纳郡贝莱克附近的厄恩河上爆发，是九年战争前期的一场战斗。交战双方是休·马圭尔率领的盖尔爱尔兰军队，以及亨利·巴格纳尔爵士率领、休·奥尼尔支持的英国王室远征军。马圭尔是弗马纳领主，曾起兵反抗英国统治。

en.s: The siege of Bredevoort in 1597 was a siege of Bredevoort by the military forces led by Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange, during the Eighty Years War and the Anglo-Spanish War. The siege lasted from 1 October until 9 October; after that day Bredevoort was occupied by the besiegers. The siege was part of a campaign during which Maurice conquered the cities Turnhout, Alphen, Rijnberk, Meurs, Bredevoort, Groenlo, Goor, Enschede, Oldenzaal, Ootmarsum, and Lingen.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1597年，奥兰治亲王毛里茨率军围攻布雷德福特，战事发生在八十年战争和英西战争期间。围城从10月1日持续到10月9日，次日围城部队占领了布雷德福特。此次围城属于一场军事行动的一部分；毛里茨在行动中攻取了图恩豪特、阿尔芬、赖因贝克、默尔斯、布雷德福特、格罗恩洛、戈尔、恩斯赫德、奥尔登扎尔、奥特马瑟姆和林根等城市。

en.t: Dutch and Johor ships attack the Portuguese blockade
en.s: On October 10, 1603, Dutch and Johor ships attacked the Portuguese armada blockading the Johor River. This second attack drove most of the Portuguese crew from their ships toward Batam, according to the National Library Board of Singapore’s account of the battle.

zh.t: 荷兰与柔佛船队攻击葡萄牙封锁舰队
zh.s: 1603年10月10日，荷兰与柔佛船队攻击了封锁柔佛河的葡萄牙舰队。新加坡国家图书馆记载，这次第二轮攻击迫使大部分葡萄牙船员弃船，逃往巴淡岛。

en.s: The Battle of Vízvár was an engagement that took place on October 10, at Vízvár in Csallóköz in Lower Hungary. The 15,000-strong united Christian army (joined by two German regiments) ambushed and defeated the Turkish rearguard. 600 Turks were killed in the battle, while the Hungarians suffered only 12 casualties.

zh.s: 维兹瓦尔战役于10月10日在下匈牙利的乔洛科兹地区维兹瓦尔发生。一支由1.5万人组成的基督教联军（另有两个德意志团参战）设伏击败了土耳其后卫部队。战斗中约600名土耳其人阵亡，匈牙利方面仅有12人伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Gaivoron (Ukrainian: Битва під Гайвороном) was a battle that took place on 10 of October 1668 during the Left-Bank uprising between the Crimean cavalry and the Zaporozhian Cossacks led by Grigoriy Doroshenko and kalga Qirim-Giray from one side and the Russian forces led by Andrey Romodanovsky on the other.

zh.s: 海沃龙战役（乌克兰语：Битва під Гайвороном）于1668年10月10日爆发，是左岸起义期间的一场战斗。交战双方分别是格里戈里·多罗申科率领的克里米亚骑兵与扎波罗热哥萨克、克里米亚汗国卡尔加·克里姆·吉雷，以及安德烈·罗莫达诺夫斯基率领的俄罗斯军队。

en.s: The capture of Vigo and Pontevedra (also known as the British expedition to Vigo and Pontevedra) occurred in October 1719 during the War of the Quadruple Alliance when a British expedition made a descent on the Spanish coast. They then captured the settlements of Vigo, Redondela and Pontevedra after some resistance, which they occupied for ten days destroying or capturing a vast haul of military stores before withdrawing.

zh.t: 维戈与蓬特韦德拉之战
zh.s: 维戈与蓬特韦德拉之战也称英国远征维戈与蓬特韦德拉，发生于1719年10月四国同盟战争期间。英国远征军登陆西班牙海岸，经过一番抵抗后攻占维戈、雷东德拉和蓬特韦德拉，并占领这些城镇10天，摧毁或缴获大量军需物资后撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Lutterberg took place on 10 October 1758 during the Seven Years' War between a French force of 42,000 commanded by Charles, Prince of Soubise and a much smaller Anglo-German force commanded by General Christoph Ludwig von Oberg. The two armies clashed near the town of Lutterberg, Lower Saxony. The 14,000 mostly Prussian Allied troops, were overwhelmed by several charges of French cavalry and were forced to withdraw.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，卢特贝格战役于1758年10月10日爆发。苏比斯亲王夏尔率领4.2万人的法军，对阵克里斯托夫·路德维希·冯·奥贝格将军率领、规模小得多的英德联军。两军在下萨克森州卢特贝格镇附近交战。1.4万名以普鲁士人为主的盟军遭到法国骑兵多次冲锋，被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Point Pleasant, also known as the Battle of Kanawha and the Battle of Great Kanawha, was the only major action of Dunmore's War. It was fought on October 10, 1774, between the Virginia militia and Shawnee and Mingo warriors. Along the Ohio River near modern-day Point Pleasant, West Virginia, forces under the Shawnee chief Cornstalk attacked Virginia militiamen under Colonel Andrew Lewis, hoping to halt Lewis's advance into the Ohio Valley.

zh.s: 波因特普莱森特之战又称卡诺瓦之战或大卡诺瓦之战，是邓莫尔战争期间唯一一场大型战斗。1774年10月10日，弗吉尼亚民兵与肖尼人、明戈人战士在俄亥俄河附近、今西弗吉尼亚州波因特普莱森特一带交战。肖尼族首领玉米梗率军袭击安德鲁·刘易斯上校率领的弗吉尼亚民兵，试图阻止他们向俄亥俄河谷推进。

en.s: The Great Hurricane of 1780 was the deadliest tropical cyclone in the Western Hemisphere. An estimated 22,000 people died throughout the Lesser Antilles when the storm passed through the islands from October 10 to October 16. Specifics on the hurricane's track and strength are unknown, as the official Atlantic hurricane database only goes back to 1851.
en.n: The Great Hurricane of 1780 kills 20,000–30,000 in the Caribbean.

zh.s: 1780年大飓风是西半球伤亡最惨重的热带气旋。风暴于10月10日至16日经过小安的列斯群岛，据估计造成约22,000人死亡。风暴路径和强度不明，因为官方大西洋飓风数据库的记录始于1851年。
zh.n: 1780年大飓风在加勒比地区造成20,000至30,000人死亡。

en.s: On October 10, 1787, Amsterdam capitulated during the Prussian invasion of the Dutch Republic. Prussian troops entered the city through the Leidsepoort.

zh.t: 阿姆斯特丹向普鲁士军队投降
zh.s: 1787年10月10日，阿姆斯特丹在普鲁士入侵荷兰共和国期间投降。普鲁士军队随后从莱顿门进入城内。

en.t: Kościuszko is wounded and captured at Maciejowice
en.s: On October 10, 1794, the Polish army was defeated at the Battle of Maciejowice. Tadeusz Kościuszko was wounded and taken prisoner.

zh.t: 科希丘什科在马切约维采负伤被俘
zh.s: 1794年10月10日，波兰军队在马切约维采战役中战败。塔德乌什·科希丘什科负伤后被俘。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey, 1798
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in New Jersey for the 6th Congress were held October 10, 1798.

zh.t: 1798年新泽西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1798年10月10日，新泽西州举行美国众议院第六届国会代表选举。

en.s: The Battle of Saalfeld took place on 10 October 1806, at which a French force of 12,800 men commanded by Marshal Jean Lannes defeated a Prussian-Saxon force of 8,300 men under Prince Louis Ferdinand. The battle took place in Thuringia in what was the Ernestine duchy of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The battle was the second clash in the Prussian Campaign of the War of the Fourth Coalition.

zh.s: 1806年10月10日的萨尔费尔德之战中，让·拉纳元帅率领的1.28万法军击败路易·费迪南王子率领的8300名普鲁士—萨克森联军。战斗发生在图林根的萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德公国境内。这是第四次反法同盟战争普鲁士战役中的第二次交锋。

en.s: The defense of the cutter Eagle was a battle on and around Long Island New York, that took place from October 10 to 13, 1814, between the British Royal Navy and the United States' Revenue Marine. en.s: The 1911 Revolution, also known as the Xinhai Revolution or Hsinhai Revolution, culminated in the end of China's last imperial dynasty, the Qing dynasty, and led to the establishment of the Republic of China (ROC). The revolution was the culmination of a decade of agitation, revolts, and uprisings. Its success marked the end of Chinese monarchy, the 267-year reign of the Qing, over two millennia of imperial rule in China, and the beginning of China's early republican era. The Qing had long struggled to reform the government and resist foreign aggression, but conservatives in the Qing court opposed the program of reforms after 1900 as too radical and reformers considered it too slow. Several factions, including underground anti-Qing groups, revolutionaries in exile, reformers who wanted to save the monarchy by modernizing it, and activists across the country debated how or whether to overthrow the Qing dynasty. The flashpoint came on 10 October 1911 with the Wuchang Uprising, an armed rebellion by members of the New Army.

zh.s: 辛亥革命又称1911年革命，最终结束了中国最后一个帝制王朝清朝，并促成中华民国成立。这场革命是十年间持续鼓动、起义和叛乱的结果。革命成功标志着中国君主制、清朝267年统治以及两千多年的帝制结束，也开启了中国早期共和时期。清廷长期试图改革政府、抵御外国侵略，但1900年后，朝中保守派认为改革方案过于激进，改革派则认为步子太慢。包括地下反清团体、流亡革命者、希望通过现代化挽救君主制的改革派以及各地活动人士在内的多个派别，都在讨论是否以及如何推翻清朝。1911年10月10日，新军成员发动武昌起义，革命由此进入关键阶段。

en.s: On October 10, 1914, General Werbrouck confirmed Antwerp’s surrender and ordered the remaining fortress troops to capitulate. Fighting around the remaining forts stopped that day.
en.n: German troops entered the undefended city on October 9. This entry records the surrender of the remaining fortress troops on October 10.

zh.t: 安特卫普剩余要塞向德军投降
zh.s: 1914年10月10日，安特卫普要塞参谋长韦尔布鲁克将军确认了投降协议，并下令剩余守军投降。当日，安特卫普周边剩余要塞的战斗也告停止。
zh.n: 德军于10月9日进入未设防的安特卫普市区。本条记录的是10月10日剩余要塞守军投降。

en.s: The 1915 Copa de Honor Municipalidad de Buenos Aires was the final that decided the champion of the 10th. edition of this National cup of Argentina. In the match, held in Racing Club Stadium in Avellaneda, Racing Club beat Tiro Federal (that played its first final) 2–1, winning its third consecutive Copa de Honor trophy.

zh.t: 1915年布宜诺斯艾利斯市荣誉杯决赛
zh.s: 1915年布宜诺斯艾利斯市荣誉杯决赛决出了该项阿根廷国内杯赛第10届冠军。比赛在阿韦亚内达的竞技俱乐部球场举行，竞技俱乐部以2比1击败首次打入决赛的蒂罗联邦队，连续第三次夺得荣誉杯。

en.s: The Battle of Cambrai, 1918 (also known as the Second Battle of Cambrai) was a battle between troops of the British First, Third and Fourth Armies and German Empire forces during the Hundred Days Offensive of the First World War. The battle took place in and around the French city of Cambrai, between 8 and 10 October 1918. The battle incorporated many of the newer tactics of 1918, in particular tanks. The attack was an overwhelming success with light casualties in an extremely short amount of time.

zh.s: 1918年康布雷战役又称第二次康布雷战役，是第一次世界大战百日攻势期间，英国第一、第三和第四集团军与德意志帝国军队之间的一场战斗。战斗于1918年10月8日至10日在法国康布雷市及周边地区进行。双方使用了许多1918年较新的战术，尤其是坦克。进攻在很短时间内取得压倒性胜利，伤亡较轻。

en.s: The Taranaki by-election of 1918 was a by-election in the Taranaki electorate on the west coast of the North Island. It was held during the 19th New Zealand Parliament, on 10 October 1918. It was caused by the death of incumbent MP Henry Okey of the Reform Party and was won by Sydney George Smith, the son of previous Taranaki MP Edward Metcalf Smith, who stood as an independent Labour candidate. Smith supported the war effort unlike most Labour politicians, gaining him support of voters who likewise supported the war.

zh.s: 1918年塔拉纳基选区补选在北岛西海岸的塔拉纳基选区举行，投票日为1918年10月10日，当时新西兰第19届议会仍在任。补选因改革党议员亨利·奥基去世而举行，由独立工党候选人悉尼·乔治·史密斯胜出。他是前塔拉纳基议员爱德华·梅特卡夫·史密斯的儿子。与大多数工党政治人物不同，史密斯支持战争，因此也得到持相同立场选民的支持。

en.s: The Battle of St Quentin Canal was a pivotal battle of World War I that began on 29 September 1918 and involved British, Australian and American forces operating as part of the British Fourth Army under the overall command of General Sir Henry Rawlinson. Further north, part of the British Third Army also supported the attack.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣康坦运河战役是第一次世界大战中的关键战役，于1918年9月29日打响。英国、澳大利亚和美国部队参战，由亨利·罗林森爵士将军总指挥的英国第四集团军负责统领。更北面的部分英国第三集团军也参与了进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Jahra was a battle during the Kuwait–Najd War fought between Kuwaiti forces and Saudi-supported militants. The battle took place in Al Jahra, west of Kuwait City on October 10, 1920 around the Kuwait Red Fort.

zh.s: 杰赫拉战役是科威特—内志战争期间的一场战斗，交战双方是科威特军队和沙特支持的武装分子。1920年10月10日，双方在科威特城以西的杰赫拉、科威特红堡附近交战。

en.s: The Carinthian plebiscite (German: Kärntner Volksabstimmung, Slovene: Koroški plebiscit) was held on 10 October 1920 in the area in southern Carinthia predominantly settled by Carinthian Slovenes. It determined the final border between the Republic of Austria and the newly formed Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (Yugoslavia) after World War I. The predominantly Slovene-speaking plebiscite area voted to remain part of Austria with a 59% majority.

zh.s: 克恩顿公民投票（德语：Kärntner Volksabstimmung；斯洛文尼亚语：Koroški plebiscit）于1920年10月10日在克恩顿州南部举行，当地居民以克恩顿斯洛文尼亚人为主。投票决定第一次世界大战后奥地利共和国与新成立的塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国（南斯拉夫）之间的最终边界。以斯洛文尼亚语为主要语言的投票地区中，59%的选民投票支持留在奥地利。

en.s: On 10 October 1933, a Boeing 247 airliner operated by United Air Lines and registered as NC13304 crashed near Chesterton, Indiana. The transcontinental flight, carrying three crew and four passengers, had originated in Newark, New Jersey, with its final destination in Oakland, California. It had already landed in Cleveland and was headed to its next stop in Chicago when it exploded en route. All aboard died in the crash, which was proven to have been deliberately caused by an on-board explosive device. Eyewitnesses on the ground reported hearing an explosion shortly after 9 p.m., and saw the aircraft in flames at an altitude of about 1,000 feet (300 m).

zh.t: 1933年联合航空波音247空中爆炸事件
zh.s: 1933年10月10日，联合航空一架注册号为NC13304的波音247客机在印第安纳州切斯特顿附近坠毁。这架横贯大陆的航班载有3名机组人员和4名乘客，从新泽西州纽瓦克起飞，终点为加利福尼亚州奥克兰。飞机已在克利夫兰降落，正飞往下一站芝加哥途中发生爆炸。机上人员全部遇难；调查证实，爆炸是有人故意在机上放置爆炸装置造成的。地面目击者称，晚上9点刚过不久听到爆炸声，并看到飞机在约1,000英尺（300米）高空起火。

en.t: A military coup abolishes the Second Hellenic Republic
en.s: On October 10, 1935, a military coup abolished Greece’s republican system and the 1927 Constitution, restoring the 1911 Constitution. A U.S. diplomatic dispatch the next day reported the assembly’s abolition of the republican regime and restoration of the monarchical constitution.

zh.t: 军事政变废除希腊第二共和国
zh.s: 1935年10月10日，军事政变废除了希腊共和政体和1927年宪法，恢复1911年宪法。美国外交档案记载，议会于次日晚间宣布废除共和政体，并恢复君主制宪法。

en.s: The Sinyavino offensive (or third Sinyavino offensive) was an operation planned by the Soviet Union in the summer of 1942 with the aim of breaking the siege of Leningrad, which had begun the previous summer, to establish a reliable supply line to Leningrad. At the same time, German forces were planning Operation Northern Light (German: Nordlicht) to capture the city and link up with Finnish forces.

zh.s: 1942年夏季，苏联策划了锡尼亚维诺攻势（又称第三次锡尼亚维诺攻势），目标是突破始于前一年的列宁格勒围城，建立一条可靠的列宁格勒补给线。与此同时，德军正在筹划“北极光”行动（德语：Nordlicht），企图攻占该城并与芬兰军队会师。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的攻势结束日期。

en.t: Roscommon wins the 1943 All-Ireland football final replay
en.s: On October 10, 1943, Roscommon and Cavan met in the replay of the All-Ireland senior football final at Croke Park. Roscommon won 2–7 to 2–2, claiming its first Sam Maguire Cup.

zh.t: 罗克芒德队赢得1943年全爱尔兰足球决赛重赛
zh.s: 1943年10月10日，罗克芒德队与卡文队在克罗克公园举行全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛重赛。罗克芒德以2比7战胜卡文的2比2，首次捧起萨姆·马圭尔杯。

en.s: The Double Tenth Agreement, formally known as the Summary of Conversations Between the Government and Representatives of the Communist Party of China, was a pact between the Kuomintang-ruled Nationalist government (KMT) and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The agreement was concluded on 10 October 1945, the Double Ten Day of the Republic of China (ROC), following 43 days of talks known as the Chongqing Negotiations (Chinese: 重慶談判).

zh.s: 《双十协定》正式名称为《政府与中共代表会谈纪要》，是由国民党执政的国民政府与中国共产党达成的协议。双方经过43天的重庆谈判后，于1945年10月10日，即中华民国双十节当天签署协定。

en.s: The Battle of Kalgan took place during the off and on mediation of a cease fire between the Kuomintang and the Chinese Communist Party by George Marshall. It was fought in the renamed city of Zhangjiakou, China.

en.s: The Battle of Nghĩa Lộ (Vietnamese: Nghĩa Lộ), also called Ly Thuong Kiet Campaign by Việt Minh, was fought between forces of the French Union and Việt Minh during the First Indochina War. Both general Giap and de Lattre waited eagerly for the battle due to the postponement that occurred when Giap's attack along the Day River were driven back in June 1951.

zh.s: 义路战役（越南语：Nghĩa Lộ）也称越盟所称的李常杰战役，是第一次印度支那战争期间法国联盟部队与越盟之间的一场战斗。武元甲和德拉特尔都急切等待这场战役，因为此前武元甲于1951年6月沿㵲江发动的攻势被击退，导致战役推迟。

en.s: The Battle of Arrowhead Hill (Korean: 화살머리고지 전투) or the Battle of Arrowhead Ridge, was a battle in which UN Forces fought against the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (CPVA) during the Korean War.

en.t: Omani forces accompany oil prospectors to Fahud
en.s: On October 10, 1954, an armed contingent of the Sultan of Muscat and Oman accompanied Iraq Petroleum Company prospectors to the Fahud site in the Omani interior. The next day, the Sultan’s forces occupied nearby Tanam.

zh.t: 阿曼军队护送石油勘探人员前往法胡德
zh.s: 1954年10月10日，阿曼苏丹武装人员护送伊拉克石油公司勘探人员进入阿曼内陆的法胡德勘探点。次日，苏丹军队占领了附近的塔纳姆。

en.s: The Windscale fire of 10 October 1957 was the worst nuclear accident in the United Kingdom's history, ranked in severity at level 5 out of 7 on the International Nuclear Event Scale. The fire was in Unit 1 of the two-pile Windscale site (now Sellafield) on the north-west coast of England in Cumberland. The two graphite-moderated reactors, referred to at the time as "piles", had been built as part of the British post-war atomic bomb project.

zh.s: 1957年10月10日发生的温斯克尔火灾是英国历史上最严重的核事故，国际核事件分级为7级中的5级。起火地点是英格兰西北海岸坎布里亚郡温斯克尔（今塞拉菲尔德）核设施的1号反应堆。该处有两座石墨慢化反应堆，当时称为“反应堆”，是英国战后原子弹项目的一部分。

en.s: The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. It is also abbreviated as the Limited Test Ban Treaty (LTBT) and Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (NTBT), though the latter may also refer to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), which succeeded the PTBT for ratifying parties.
en.n: The Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty comes into effect.

zh.s: 《部分禁止核试验条约》正式名称为《禁止在大气层、外层空间和水下进行核武器试验条约》（1963年），禁止除地下试验外的一切核武器试爆。该条约也简称《有限禁止核试验条约》或《核试验禁约》；但后一个名称有时也指后来取代该条约、适用于批准国的《全面禁止核试验条约》。

en.t: Indonesian survivors of the Long Jawai ambush are killed
en.s: On October 10, 1963, the Indonesian survivors of an October 1 ambush at Long Jawai were killed in another ambush. The account does not identify who carried out the October 10 ambush.

zh.t: 龙贾怀伏击战中印尼幸存者被杀
zh.s: 1963年10月10日，10月1日在龙贾怀伏击中幸存的印尼人员，在另一次伏击中被杀。现有记载没有说明10月10日伏击者的身份。

en.s: General elections were held in Libya on 10 October 1964. Following the 1952 elections political parties had been banned, so all candidates contested the election as independents. Although its spokesmen were arrested, the opposition managed to obtain representation in parliament. As a result, King Idris dissolved the Assembly and early elections were held the following year.

zh.s: 利比亚于1964年10月10日举行大选。1952年选举后，利比亚已禁止政党活动，因此所有候选人都以独立人士身份参选。尽管反对派发言人遭到逮捕，反对派仍成功在议会取得席位。此后伊德里斯国王解散议会，并于次年提前举行选举。

en.t: Tokyo Olympics opening ceremony is relayed live by satellite
en.s: The opening ceremony of the Tokyo Olympics took place at the National Stadium on October 10, 1964. NBC’s live East Coast U.S. coverage was relayed by the Syncom III satellite, the first live satellite transmission of an Olympic event.

zh.t: 东京奥运会开幕式首次通过卫星向海外直播
zh.s: 1964年10月10日，东京奥运会在国立竞技场举行开幕式。美国东海岸的NBC直播信号由“辛科姆三号”卫星转播，这是首次通过卫星直播奥运赛事。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 10 October 1965. The result was a victory for the Justice Party, which won 240 of the 450 seats. Voter turnout was 71.3%.

zh.s: 土耳其于1965年10月10日举行大选。正义党获胜，赢得450席中的240席。投票率为71.3%。

en.s: General elections were held in Spain on 10 October 1967 where Spanish citizens elected 102 of the 564 members of the Cortes Españolas, the Spanish legislature. It was the first election held in Spain since the 1936 general election before the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939) and the first general election held during the dictatorship of Francisco Franco.

en.s: The Outer Space Treaty, formally called the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies, is a multilateral treaty that forms the basis of international space law. Negotiated and drafted under the auspices of the United Nations, it was opened for signature in the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Soviet Union on 27 January 1967, entering into force on 10 October 1967.
en.n: The Outer Space Treaty comes into force.

zh.s: 《外层空间条约》正式名称为《关于各国探索和利用外层空间（包括月球和其他天体）活动所应遵守原则的条约》，是一项多边条约，也是国际空间法的基础。条约由联合国主持谈判和起草，于1967年1月27日在美国、英国和苏联开放签署，并于1967年10月10日生效。

en.t: October 1974 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 10 October 1974, the October 1974 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, with 516 constituencies being in England. en.t: October 1974 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on Thursday 10 October 1974 and all 71 seats in Scotland were contested. This election was held just seven months after the previous general election, held in February 1974, had led to a hung parliament. Following the inconclusive nature of coalition talks between the Conservatives and other parties such as the Liberals and the Ulster Unionists, the Labour Leader Harold Wilson had gone on to form a minority government.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Dáil Éireann Dublin South-West constituency in Ireland on 10 October 2014, following the election of Fine Gael TD Brian Hayes to the European Parliament. The Electoral (Amendment) Act 2011 stipulates that a by-election in Ireland must be held within six months of a vacancy occurring. The Roscommon–South Leitrim by-election was held on the same date. Paul Murphy of the Anti-Austerity Alliance was elected on the eighth count. Murphy's victory came as a surprise as Sinn Féin had performed extremely well in local elections the previous May, winning 50.3% of the first preference vote in the Tallaght South LEA and 32% in the Tallaght Central LEA, and were widely predicted to win the seat.

zh.s: 2014年10月10日，爱尔兰国会下院都柏林西南选区举行补选，起因是统一党议员布赖恩·海斯当选欧洲议会议员。爱尔兰《2011年选举法修正案》规定，议席出缺后必须在六个月内举行补选。同日还举行了罗斯康芒—南利特里姆选区补选。反紧缩联盟候选人保罗·墨菲在第八轮计票后当选。墨菲胜选出乎意料：新芬党在前一年5月的地方选举中表现突出，在塔拉特南选区首选票占50.3%，在塔拉特中央选区占32%，因此外界普遍预测该党会赢得这个议席。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Dáil Éireann Roscommon–South Leitrim constituency in Ireland on 10 October 2014, following the election of Independent TD Luke 'Ming' Flanagan to the European Parliament. The Dublin South-West by-election was held on the same date. The Electoral (Amendment) Act 2011 stipulates that a by-election in Ireland must be held within six months of a vacancy occurring.

en.s: On 10 October 2015 at 10:04 local time (EEST) in Ankara, the capital city of Turkey, two bombs were detonated outside Ankara Central railway station. en.s: The CONCACAF Cup (officially the CONCACAF Cup presented by Scotiabank for sponsorship reasons) was an international soccer play-off match to determine CONCACAF's entry into the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup. The 2013 CONCACAF Gold Cup winner United States played against the 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup winner Mexico on October 10, 2015, at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, United States.

zh.s: 中北美洲及加勒比海国家杯（因赞助而正式称为“Scotiabank赞助的中北美洲及加勒比海国家杯”）是一场国际足球附加赛，决定中北美洲及加勒比海足球协会赛区参加2017年国际足联联合会杯的球队。2013年美洲金杯冠军美国队与2015年美洲金杯冠军墨西哥队于2015年10月10日在美国帕萨迪纳玫瑰碗球场交锋。

en.t: Trinidad and Tobago v United States (2018 FIFA World Cup qualification)
en.s: On October 10, 2017, Trinidad and Tobago played against the United States at the Ato Boldon Stadium in Couva in what was the final 2018 FIFA World Cup qualification match for both teams. Trinidad and Tobago won the match 2–1 which resulted in the United States missing their first World Cup since 1986, as well as Trinidad and Tobago's first win over the United States since 2008, and their third win against them in international association football.

zh.t: 特立尼达和多巴哥对美国（2018年世界杯预选赛）
zh.s: 2017年10月10日，特立尼达和多巴哥在库瓦的阿托·博尔顿体育场迎战美国，这是两队2018年世界杯预选赛的最后一场比赛。特立尼达和多巴哥以2比1获胜，导致美国队自1986年以来首次无缘世界杯。这也是特立尼达和多巴哥自2008年以来首次战胜美国队，也是两队进行国际足球比赛以来，特立尼达和多巴哥第三次击败美国队。

en.s: The Battle of Avdiivka was a major battle between the Russian and Ukrainian Armed Forces for control of Avdiivka, a city in Donetsk Oblast, during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present). After more than a year and a half of intermittent fighting along the city's outskirts, Russian forces launched an offensive to capture Avdiivka on 10 October 2023, resulting in what was considered one of the bloodiest and fiercest battles of the war.

zh.s: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役是俄乌战争（2022年至今）期间，俄罗斯和乌克兰武装部队争夺顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡控制权的一场重要战役。双方在该市郊区断断续续交战一年半多后，俄军于2023年10月10日发动攻势，试图夺取阿夫迪伊夫卡。这场战斗被认为是战争中最血腥、最激烈的战役之一。
